amends.relation: supplements Amendment 07; Amendment 07 itself is not modified

replaces: no FinBERT or any other model is run
sentiment scores are not an input of any of the 8 features; where a generator needs one a constant placeholder is passed
correction.with: sealed articles are scored with the frozen 11B.2 FinBERT pipeline below, offline, and their labels are used only for event__negative_event_count

equivalence_gate.on_failure: stop; no sealed record is read; the requirement is never weakened
equivalence_gate.requirement: 500/500 fresh labels equal the stored 11B.2 labels
equivalence_gate.selection: sort by sha256('phase12|erratum01|' + article_key), take the first 500
equivalence_gate.when: in the same process, after the development feature reproduction and before any sealed inference

finbert.label_rule: argmax of softmax(logits); ties broken in the label order above
finbert.text_policy: text_v1: headline + ' ' + summary (whitespace-collapsed; summary dropped if it repeats the headline); content (HTML stripped) only if both are empty; never URLs, ids, symbols, timestamps or source
finbert.tokenizer: AutoTokenizer of the pinned revision; truncation by tokens at max_length; padding to the longest text of a batch (none for a single text); attention mask

no_substitution: no other model, revision, tokenizer, text policy, truncation, padding, batch size, device or label mapping; any difference stops the build
permitted_use: the label of each sealed article, as an input of event__negative_event_count only
qualification_statement: Q1-Q6 and the CONFIRMED rule are exactly those of Amendment 07

qualification_unchanged.Q1_improvement: relative MSE improvement >= 0.01 AND relative MAE improvement >= 0.0
qualification_unchanged.Q2_statistics: DM p < 0.05 AND p with lag 2L < 0.05
qualification_unchanged.Q3_periods: MSE better in >= 3 of 4 equal consecutive blocks of sealed dates
qualification_unchanged.Q4_separation: artifacts trained only on rows with labels <= 2024-09-30; every evaluated row has t >= 2024-10-01 and t+1 <= 2026-09-25; no estimator is fitted during the run
qualification_unchanged.Q5_breadth: MSE improved for >= 60% of stocks, and still > 0 without the best stock and without the best quarter (63-session chunks of sealed dates; a final chunk < 21 merged into the previous one)
qualification_unchanged.Q6_reproducibility: artifact and model fingerprints and development prediction fingerprints match the pins, and a second in-process inference on the sealed rows is bit-identical
qualification_unchanged.rule: CONFIRMED only if Q1-Q6 all pass

reason: Amendment 07 sealed_feature_build says no FinBERT run is needed and sentiment is not an input of the 8 features. That is wrong for event__negative_event_count: event_features_v1 counts events whose article FinBERT label is negative (services.event_taxonomy.impact_from_sentiment_label). A placeholder label would make the feature constant on sealed data.
restriction: no FinBERT output feeds any other feature: the other 7 features and their generation rules are unchanged and must be identical whatever the sentiment values (tested); sentiment scores, ratios and means are never used
sealed_access: this erratum authorizes no sealed access, sealed inference, sealed feature generation or confirmation; those need the owner's separate authorization record
status: APPROVED by the project owner (Stage 3C); written before any sealed record is read
unchanged: the other 7 features and every generation rule
